sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: After helping the armored man come back to his senses, Thedio learned that the mystic armor was made from the same material as his own mystic shield. Before he could ask the man how he had ended up in that situation, a strong magical power manifested from the three mystic weapons. Although he should have been terrified of the menacing shadow before him, he did not falter and protected the man and the boy until the very end. Following this battle, he decided to join the boy and the scholar in their travels, but no one really knows what motivated him to do this.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Flaming Shield Thedio |bf2 = true }} '''Thedio''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== After helping the armored man come back to his senses, Thedio learned that the mystic armor was made from the same material as his own mystic shield. Before he could ask the man how he had ended up in that situation, a strong magical power manifested from the three mystic weapons. Although he should have been terrified of the menacing shadow before him, he did not falter and protected the man and the boy until the very end. Following this battle, he decided to join the boy and the scholar in their travels, but no one really knows what motivated him to do this. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Thedio |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 127 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 127 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 127 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 127 3.png |image4note = Shock |image5 = Navi chara bf2 127 4.png |image5note = Hurt }} {{CharacterImage |name = Thedio with Shield |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 128 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 128 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 128 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 128 3.png |image4note = Shock |image5 = Navi chara bf2 128 4.png |image5note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
